trails.name: Corpus Foundations  & Custom Training
trails.reason: Start with the basics of document corpus formats, then learn how to build a custom corpus for Annif projects, linking format choices to training and evaluation.

trails.name: Annif Implementation  & Evaluation
trails.reason: Use the Annif client, follow the handbook for setup, explore lemmatization methods to improve indexing, and assess results with editing quality metrics.

trails.name: Advanced Backend  & Ensemble Learning
trails.reason: Deploy the MLLM backend, combine projects with a neural network ensemble backend, and train the ensemble on real data to achieve robust subject indexing.

trails.name: Fire Safety Documentation  & Automated Tagging
trails.reason: Apply buildvoc tagging to fire safety guidance, use AI retrieval tools, track updates and roadmap, demonstrating end‑to‑end ML workflow for regulated documents.
